name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the BlueAir Purifier platform in Homebridge.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for BlueAir account. This should be filled in automatically in the discovery process.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for BlueAir account. This should be filled in automatically in the discovery process.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region for BlueAir account. This should be filled in automatically in the discovery process.

accountUuid.title: Account UUID
accountUuid.description: Account UUID for BlueAir account. This should be filled in automatically in the discovery process.

autoExposeAvailableServices.title: Auto Expose Available Services
autoExposeAvailableServices.description: Automatically create HomeKit services when a device payload shows support. Disable per device with Disabled Services.

realtimeSensors.title: Realtime Sensors
realtimeSensors.description: Use Blueair AWS IoT realtime sensor streams when REST polling does not include live sensor values.

sensorProbeEnabled.title: Sensor Probe Enabled
sensorProbeEnabled.description: Diagnostic flag used by the capture command. Leave disabled during normal Homebridge runtime.

verboseLogging.title: Verbose Logging
verboseLogging.description: Enable to receive detailed log messages. Useful for troubleshooting.

uiDebug.title: UI Debug
uiDebug.description: Enable to show debug information in the Homebridge UI.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval
pollingInterval.description: Interval in miliseconds to poll the BlueAir API for updates. It's recommended to keep this at least 15 seconds (15000 miliseconds).

filterChangeLevel.title: Filter Change Level
filterChangeLevel.description: Percentage of filter life remaining to trigger a filter change alert.

temperatureInputUnit.title: Temperature Input Unit
temperatureInputUnit.description: Unit used by Blueair for this device. Auto treats unusually high values as Fahrenheit and converts them to Celsius for HomeKit.

fanSpeedMax.title: Fan Speed Max
fanSpeedMax.description: Raw maximum fan speed reported by the device. Leave 0 to infer from observed values.

brightnessMax.title: Brightness Max
brightnessMax.description: Raw maximum LED brightness reported by the device. Leave 0 to infer from observed values.

disabledServices.title: Disabled Services
disabledServices.description: Services to suppress even when auto exposure detects support.

led.title: LED
led.description: Toggles if the LED switch service is created with the accessory.

airQualitySensor.title: Air Quality Sensor
airQualitySensor.description: Toggles if the air quality sensor service is created with the accessory.

temperatureSensor.title: Temperature Sensor
temperatureSensor.description: Toggles if the temperature sensor service is created with the accessory.

humiditySensor.title: Humidity Sensor
humiditySensor.description: Toggles if the humidity sensor service is created with the accessory.

germShield.title: Germ Shield
germShield.description: Toggles if the germ shield switch service is created with the accessory.

nightMode.title: Night Mode
nightMode.description: Toggles if the night mode switch service is created with the accessory.
